Strategy: Test the best pure bonus band from the other island here, rewarding leftovers between twenty-eight and forty-two with no penalty. It may help if the band generalizes across seeds, but may fail if the win was specific to the other seed.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
